business_problem: turn large, fast-moving campaign and consumer data into near-real-time programmatic insight so teams can troubleshoot, optimize spend, and prove ad delivery quickly.
solution_summary: Horizon Media uses Snowflake and Secure Data Sharing on Snowflake to turn large, fast-moving campaign and consumer data into near-real-time programmatic insight so teams can troubleshoot, optimize spend, and prove ad delivery quickly. Campaign, impression, and consumer data are centralized in Snowflake so programmatic and analytics teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Secure Data Sharing lets the organization collaborate with partners or downstream consumers on live governed data without creating extra copies. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Horizon Media achieved <5 Seconds to see if ads are live and gauge campaign success vs. hours or minutes previously and 15 Minutes to understand if publishers accepted ad creative — down from hours.
